# Watchkeeper

> Open-source (MIT) full-IDE AI coding control plane for Claude Code and Google Antigravity by Nexodyne: combines fail-closed tool/secret guards, evidence-verified completion gates, a spend ledger, an integrated **Re-Prompt** normalization studio (`rp:*` / `raw:`), a **Running Tasks** cockpit, an auto-updating **Skills Library** that discovers trending/top-starred GitHub `SKILL.md` repos daily (`com.nexodyne.watchkeeper-skill-sync`), Graphify codebase knowledge graphs, and a **Gemini queue**: when Claude Code plan or rate limits run out, the task waits in a local file queue (`wk-task`) until you run `/wk-take-task` in Antigravity. Keeps all state in local files; sends nothing to Nexodyne; zero telemetry.

## Why Developers Choose Watchkeeper

- **Hands work to Antigravity when Claude Code limits run out:** `bin/wk-carbon-fallback.mjs` and `reprompt/server/orchestrator.py` put the pending job (`wk-job`), steward review visit (`wk-steward`), architecture question (`wk-ask-claude`) or Orchestrator task into the local `wk-task` file queue. Antigravity takes it when you run `/wk-take-task` there, or on an hourly automation you set up in Antigravity yourself. Watchkeeper never runs `agy` or the `gemini` CLI.
- **Always fresh Skills Library without prompt bloat:** `bin/wk-skill-sync.mjs` and `reprompt/scripts/skill_vault.py discover-trending --sync --daily` discover top trending GitHub agent skill repositories once every 24h (`--no-hooks` git hardening) and stage each new source for your OK (`wk-skill-sync pending`; only approved sources are indexed), while `core/skill_router.py` progressively composes all domain-relevant `SKILL.md` guides and `references/`/`scripts/` resources without artificial caps.
- **Unified Runtime v2.0 (`core/` + `/wk`):** `core/hook_bus.py` multiplexes all lifecycle hooks with fail-closed `PreToolUse` guards, `<5ms` loop-immune triage, Gemini 4 Frontier (`gemini-4-carbon` `high` + `gemini-4-hydrogen` `xhigh`/`high`) 4,096+ token prefix-cached prompt compilation, `<50ms` 2-hop Graphify AST ego-subgraph & blast-radius checks, and `/wk` (`wk.mjs`, `/wk doctor`, MCP `wk_command` & `wk_doctor`).
- **Full-IDE cockpit (`Cmd+Alt+W`):** Opens natively inside Antigravity IDE or VS Code as a full workspace with Live Sessions rail + **Re-Prompt**, **Running Tasks**, **Skills Library**, and **Guard & Pace** tabs under one unified Watchkeeper icon.

## Install

- **Claude Code Plugin:** `/plugin install watchkeeper --marketplace tengotengo23/nexodyne-watchkeeper` (or `/plugin marketplace add tengotengo23/nexodyne-watchkeeper` then `/plugin install watchkeeper@nexodyne`).
- **Full-IDE Extension (Antigravity / VS Code / Cursor / Windsurf):** Install `watchkeeper-panel-*.vsix` from GitHub Releases or Open VSX (`nexodyne.watchkeeper-panel`).
- **Antigravity Plugin + Graphify + Daily Skill Sync:** `node <plugin>/bin/wk-graphify.mjs install && node <plugin>/bin/wk-skill-sync.mjs install`.
- **MCP Server:** `server.json` (`io.github.tengotengo23/nexodyne-watchkeeper`) exposes `open_reprompt`, `rewrite_prompt`, `orchestrate_task`, `watchkeeper_status`, `wk_command`, `wk_doctor`, `app_vault_discover_trending`, and `app_vault_search`.
